name: task-json-trailing-newline
title: write_json omits the trailing newline on every task.json
description: common/io.py:37 builds its payload with json.dumps and writes it with no trailing newline, so every task.json written through write_json ends mid-line. Every active task.json is affected (22 of 22 at the 2026-08-07 measurement; the active set churns as tasks archive). Any later hand-edit that restores the newline doubles the resulting diff and shows a spurious 'No newline at end of file' marker.
creator: sdelmas
notes: io.py:37 writes json.dumps output with no trailing newline; active_task.py:428 appends + "\n" to an otherwise identical call, so the two writers in the same script family disagree -- an internal inconsistency, not a convention. Fourteen write_json call sites (measured 2026-08-07, re-verified 2026-08-09) -- twelve in task_store.py, two in task.py -- are affected. Measured 2026-08-07: 22 of 22 active task.json lack the newline, with no exception. The earlier 2026-08-06 count of 15 of 19 held four hand-corrected files; every one has since been rewritten by a task.py command and lost the newline again, which is the predicted failure mode observed. No .gitattributes and no .editorconfig insert_final_newline rule, so nothing catches it. io.py is tracked in .trellis/.template-hashes.json, so a code fix is upstream work. Independent of 08-06-task-create-base-branch-default. Sequencing: this task writes .trellis/spec/backend/quality-guidelines.md at order 25 in the P3 band; write-set membership and the band-aware landing sequence are documented in .trellis/tasks/08-08-trellis-backlog-hygiene/record.md.
